data.name: The Agent will disconnect until you install the new key on this machine and restart the Agent service. Make sure you can reach the machine through its console or another connection before continuing.

data.value: 此确认已过期或机器的密钥已更改。请在重试前查看详细信息。

data.value: 这将立即使当前密钥失效。
